title: hieracium onosmoides subsp. oreades
intro: Hieracium onosmoides subsp. oreades, commonly known as a subspecies of hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium onosmoides subsp. oreades include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health and to confirm its therapeutic actions.
